title: unitsGuidance
responsibility: Registers state-guidance and contract-review CLI commands, prints human or JSON reports, and preserves failing exit codes for unresolved gaps.

inputs.name: registerUnitsGuidance.units
inputs.description: Commander parent command that receives the guide <id> and check-contract [id] subcommands. It matters during CLI registration and must expose the Commander command, description, and option methods used here.

outputs.name: registerUnitsGuidance
outputs.description: Returns no value after registering the guide and check-contract subcommands. Later, those actions print a human-readable or JSON report and set process.exitCode to 1 when the report has missing states or contract findings.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: The asynchronous guide or check-contract action can reject with a failure from its awaited guideUnits or checkUnitContracts dependency, and this wrapper does not catch or translate it. The concrete error name, message, and cause are determined by those dependencies.
